goal: Integrate the BK-approved Phase 4B direct art asset set into the existing Godot playable slice as a full playable-art implementation pass, while preserving gameplay logic, movement, progression, retry behavior, and QA separation.
forbidden_changes: new gameplay object creation beyond replacing existing visual roles
movement tuning or movement verb expansion
hazard, collectible/progression, goal, retry, or timer logic changes
collision behavior changes beyond preserving existing simple collision nodes

verify.command: rg -n "Decision: approve for Phase 4B prototype testing|All eight assets are approved|implementation without separate WP" owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-007-phase4b-direct-art-KR.md

verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-037.json|game/scenes/main.tscn|runs/RUN-20260620-001.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

acceptance_criteria: A single meaningful direct-art playable integration pass is performed; the work is not split asset-by-asset.
The scene references all eight approved Phase 4B direct art assets: two backgrounds, player, platform tile, collectible, hazard marker, goal marker, and UI status panel.
Section 1 and Section 2 backgrounds are used as world-space visual backdrops only; background-internal platforms, spikes, lamps, or gate-like props are not treated as gameplay objects.
Existing platform, hazard, collectible, goal, HUD, and retry gameplay nodes remain separate and inspectable.
Core labels remain available for first-pass QA readability: HAZARD, ITEM, Goal, and section/status labels may be repositioned but not fully removed.
Limited visual alignment is allowed: position, scale, z-index, background crop or layering, camera limits, and label/HUD placement.
Player movement, hazard fail behavior, collectible/progression gating, goal success behavior, timer behavior, and retry behavior are not changed.

No new generated art, final art direction, production asset approval, launch/public usage approval, paid tool adoption, QA review, Learning Card, lifecycle move, push, merge, or deployment is performed.

WP, Run, Godot import, smoke test, clean-output check, headless runtime, direct-art scene references, player-script unchanged check, and scope-diff verification pass or failures are recorded honestly.
The result is handed off to a separate QA Work Package for independent readability, import stability, playability, and scope review.
notes: This Work Package implements BK-approved direct art into the existing Phase 4B playable slice as one bounded implementation pass. It intentionally broadens beyond a tiny integration-only slice by covering the full direct-art set, while preserving the core boundaries agreed in the grill session: QA remains separate, labels remain, backgrounds are visual-only, scene alignment may be adjusted, and gameplay logic is not changed. Codex is the execution path under the current workspace policy; Samantha harness routing is not required or used.
